findings.summary: Excluding extension members hides ACL and security changes to public PostGIS functions: revoking EXECUTE on public.st_x(public.geometry) leaves the snapshot unchanged because extension keys record only schema and version.

disposition.reason: Known limitation, same as conformance D12 (justified): extension members in public are compared by installation metadata only; member owner/ACL/definition coverage is tracked in #118 (David, 2026-11-21).

findings.summary: The fixed project IDs shared by concurrent proof or integration-test runs let Supabase reuse the same containers, so one run can modify the other's fixtures and stop its database with --no-backup.
